<issue>
Setting left_margin affects right_margin instead

#### Description

When setting the `left_margin` property on a section, it incorrectly modifies the right margin instead of the left margin.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a new document
doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]

# Try to set left margin to 1 inch
section.left_margin = Inches(1)

# Check what actually happened - the right margin gets set instead
print(f"Left margin: {section.left_margin}")
print(f"Right margin: {section.right_margin}")
```

Expected: Left margin should be set to 1 inch, right margin should remain unchanged.
Actual: Right margin gets set to 1 inch + 1 (due to an off-by-one error), left margin remains unchanged.
</issue>
